02Three identity directions

Recommended for refinement: 01 Monolith
01 / Recommended

Monolith

A compact forged F. Strong silhouette, clear counterform and a chamfered edge give the core product its weight.

02 / Alternative

Keystone

A controlled passage formed by structural parts. An architectural expression of independent approvals.

03 / Alternative

Cutword

Distinctive lettering does the work. A sharp, compact identity for documentation and institutional materials.

Generated concept artwork. Exact color values come from the tokens. The selected direction needs an editable vector master before product use.

05Rules that hold it together

Clear hierarchy

4px rhythm, restrained borders and square surfaces. Space and typography make the important information obvious.

Visible control

Amounts, assets and destinations stay readable before approval. Approval status and settlement status remain distinct.

Quiet confidence

Small, purposeful motion. Calm copy. Real product evidence. The interface carries the same discipline as the infrastructure.

06Why this reference

The IBM entry in VoltAgent's collection offers the strongest starting point for FORGE's traditional-bank audience: enterprise hierarchy, readable typography and flat geometry. FORGE adds its own copper identity, complete dark adaptation and financial workflow language.
